status: PROPOSAL ONLY. Not applied to production. Requires owner review and separate approval.

script.title: The Most Photogenic Places on Earth

preservedFields: every scene's narration (must match the saved text exactly)
approval records and the approval queue

changes.note: three-destination recap in the approved order Antelope Canyon, Burano, Santorini. One clip per place, each at least its equal share (about 2.17 s at 6.52 s). A missing place fails closed: the job is refused, never a still. The schema, Apps Script bridge and worker validation are implemented on the branch; production is unchanged.

keywordPolicy.chosen: place-led keywords. The place is the first keyword, so a clip must contain the place name, and the subject words only rank clips.
keywordPolicy.consequence: Relevance is place-only. Clips that show the place without the described shot (for example a ground-level canyon clip for a drone shot) are accepted. Owner decision required.
keywordPolicy.rejectedAlternative: subject-led keywords (for example 'sandstone light beams', 'terraces aerial sea'). These match no Pexels slugs for the place, so the planner finds no clips for scenes 1, 2 and 4, and it would need 3 AI stills.

expectedCoverage.method: Pexels search metadata only, through the worker's planner. No narration, alignment, images or downloads. Scene durations are the saved estimatedSeconds, not aligned beat timings.

footageDepth.Antelope Canyon: 4 relevant clips; 2 are used by scenes 1 and 2, 2 remain for the recap

openRisks: Subject accuracy is not verified by metadata. Each chosen clip needs a human look before any render.
Scene timing uses estimatedSeconds. The real beat timings come from alignment and may move the coverage numbers.
Montage parts share the scene equally (about 2.2 s each). That is a short cut, so review the recap pacing.
The approved narration must be verified byte-for-byte before applying any metadata change.
